text: First snow falls. Grandma's old heater says NO.
Don't fuss. I have my old heater.
Grandma... what is that plugged into?
Never plug a space heater into an extension cord or a power strip, says CPSC!
She's getting a new one. Tonight.
Good call. Check before you buy any heater.
Find the model number, check the recall notice.
CPSC notice 27-054, October 29, 2026: Dreo DR-HSH015, black, remote, recalled for fire and burn hazard. About 338,800 units in the US.
Straight into the wall! Three feet clear of drapes, furniture and bedding, per CPSC.
Set it near 68°F. Eco mode stops heating once the room gets there, says Dreo.
Off when you sleep or leave, say CPSC and NFPA. Goodnight, Grandma!
